pr_summary: Fix JSON serialization of the `v` component in Ethereum signature to emit hex-encoded format instead of plain integer. The fix modifies `crates/primitives/src/signature/sig.rs` to wrap the `v` value in `crate::U64::from()` for both human-readable (JSON) and non-human-readable (binary) serialization paths.

notes: This is a Rust workspace project (alloy-rs/core) for Ethereum primitives. The fix targets the serde serialization of Signature's v component. Tests are inline in the source file under #[cfg(test)] modules. The MSRV is Rust 1.65. The project supports no_std environments. Key feature for testing is 'serde' which enables JSON serialization tests. The fix ensures v is serialized as hex (e.g., '0x1b') instead of decimal integer (e.g., 27).
